zh: 航空短訊彙整：Boom首度運轉原型引擎核心 擬供Overture客機引擎使用、英國空軍司令：無人戰機預計明年在英國空域飛行、波音獲美國空軍合約 增造15架KC-46A Pegasus加油機
en: Aviation briefs: Boom runs prototype core intended for Overture engine for first time; RAF chief says uncrewed fighters expected to fly in UK airspace next year; Boeing wins U.S. Air Force contract to build 15 more KC-46A Pegasus tankers

zh: 長榮航太：2027年維修業務約8至9成已排定
en: Evergreen Aviation Technologies says roughly 80% to 90% of 2027 maintenance work is scheduled.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：波音未向工會說明後續是否裁員 737 MAX月產47架預期延至2027年初、波音埃弗里特 737 據報納入生產證書，仍待 FAA 完成稽核、新加坡航空開航西雪梨國際機場，首班由總理黃循財搭乘
en: Aviation briefs: Boeing declines to tell a union if more layoffs will follow; 737 MAX output target slips to 2027; Boeing’s Everett 737 line reportedly added to production certificate, FAA audit still underway; Singapore Airlines begins daily Western Sydney flights with PM Lawrence Wong on the first service

zh: 土耳其空軍直升機訓練飛行時墜毀，5人死亡
en: Turkish Air Force helicopter crashes during training, killing five.

zh: 6起獨立航空事件：Wizz飛機發動機出現問題
en: Six independent aviation incidents include a Wizz engine problem near Barcelona.

zh: 國泰航空 Aria 商務艙新套房亮相 CX254
en: Cathay Pacific Aria Business Suite debut on CX254

zh: 機長 Pete Wilson 分享起飛前簡報與載重表
en: Captain Pete Wilson describes preflight briefings and load sheets.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：波蘭通報俄羅斯無人機短暫進入領空，北約準備增派預警機、燃油成本升高，航空公司評估飛機預付款融資與售後回租、墨西哥航空將改裝波音 787，787-9 首設獨立豪華經濟艙
en: Aviation briefs: Poland reports brief Russian drone incursion as NATO prepares early warning support; Airlines weigh aircraft financing and leasebacks as fuel costs rise; Aeroméxico plans 787 cabin overhaul with its first dedicated premium economy on the 787-9

zh: 國防部通報1架共機及9艘共艦，國軍監控應處
en: Taiwan reports a Chinese military aircraft and nine warships; armed forces monitored the activity.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Schiebel展示無人直升機空中釋放小型無人機、廈門航空簽約採購50架波音737 MAX 8，2031年起分批交付、俄軍機接近南韓鬱陵島，當局短暫發布避難警報
en: Aviation briefs: Schiebel demonstrates drone launch from airborne uncrewed helicopter; Xiamen Airlines signs for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets, with deliveries from 2031; South Korea briefly issues shelter alert on Ulleung Island as Russian aircraft approach
